guaranteed.title: What depends on me alone
guaranteed.body: Sessions happen even if there are four of us. The agenda is published ahead of time. The opportunities I find, I post. The price doesn't move during your year.

building.title: What depends on the members
building.body: How busy the feed is. How good the help is. How many gigs the others share. That, I can't promise you — it gets built, and you're part of it.

truth.proven1: This screen hides the Club; it doesn't forbid it. The real separation lives in the database rules: without an active subscription they refuse to read the posts, the agenda, the directory, the opportunities and the exclusive info.
truth.proven2: Nobody makes themselves a member from the browser: the rules only accept creating a subscription with the status « pending », and refuse any change of status. Only the admin activates.
truth.proven3: The price shown is the one the server charges, and it lives in exactly one place in the code.
truth.withheld1: No member count. The Club opened this year: the number would be small, so making an argument of it would mislead you, and you'd check it on the first screen after paying.
truth.withheld2: No testimonials and no star ratings. What's said inside belongs to the people inside, and a rating on a closed club can't be verified.

publicPage.includedNote: Those five lines depend on me alone. That's why they're here, and not promises about the vibe.
publicPage.guaranteeTruthTitle: Why I'm telling you this instead of selling you a dream
publicPage.guaranteeTruthBody: The Club opened this year. I won't quote you a member count, because it would be false, and because you'd check it on the first screen after paying. I'd rather you came in knowing what you're buying: a year of access to what already exists, and a seat in what's being built.

tabs.feed: What's happening this week, and what your subscription has brought you since day one.
tabs.discussions: By category: help, tools, clients. The dumb question gets asked here.
tabs.members: Who does what, and where. Private message, and a report if someone steps out of line.
tabs.agenda: Online sessions and workshops in Dakar. Sign up in one move, no double booking.
tabs.leaderboard: By joining wave, never absolute. You measure up against people who started when you did.
tabs.opportunities: Gigs, calls for tender, hiring. With the budget stated whenever it is.
tabs.infos: The weekly digest, written here and in your notifications. Not by email.
tabs.referral: Your code gets the person you bring in 15 % off. You get nothing — and I'm telling you so.

publicPage.priceBody: A yearly subscription doesn't remove the hesitation, it concentrates it into one moment. So here are both numbers up front: the one you pay, and what it works out to each month.
publicPage.renewalTitle: What happens when it runs out
publicPage.renewalBody: When it runs out, your access stops. Nothing is charged automatically: Wave and Orange Money don't support recurring debits, and I'd rather tell you than let you assume otherwise. If you asked for it, I'll email you fifteen days ahead, with a one-click link to pick it back up.
publicPage.referralNote: The discount is worked out on the server: it doesn't depend on which link you clicked.
fitTitle: And if it isn't for you,
publicPage.fitYes1: You already sell something, and you want to sell it better
publicPage.fitYes2: You work on your own, and that's the hard part
publicPage.fitYes3: You're looking for gigs, not courses
publicPage.fitNo1: You're starting from zero and want to learn a skill →
publicPage.fitNo2: You want it done for you →
publicPage.fitNo3: You just want to read and keep up →

faq.a: Not on the Club — it's yearly and doesn't split. Instalments exist on the courses, in three or four payments depending on the amount.

faq.q: What if I never show up?
faq.a: You'll have paid for nothing, and I can't stop you. That's why the recap of what your subscription has brought you sits in the feed permanently, and not only when it runs out.

faq.q: Do I get a refund if I change my mind?
faq.a: The fourteen-day withdrawal period applies to the courses. For the Club, access is immediate and complete on sign-up: write to me before paying if you're unsure, I'd rather have a conversation than a refund.

faq.q: Is the Club just one more WhatsApp group?
faq.a: No — and that's exactly why it's paid. A free group fills up with people passing through. Here the agenda, the sign-ups, the opportunities and the discussions are structured, and nobody wanders in.

publicPage.listenLede: The podcast and the videos sit on this same territory, one floor down: free, no account. People from here telling what they did. The Club is when you want to talk to them instead of listening.
publicPage.listenEmpty: No episode is online yet. When there is one, it'll be here, free and without an account.
publicPage.listenTruthTitle: What the free floor doesn't give you
publicPage.listenTruthBody: Listening is free and will stay free. What the subscription adds is elsewhere: the live sessions, the gigs that circulate, and an answer from me. The Club itself can't be toured — that's the price of keeping it closed.
publicPage.finalSecondLine: And someone on the other end.
publicPage.finalBody: If you want to judge before you pay, listen to the podcast and watch the videos: free, no account, same territory. The blog too.
